# Panels 4I-4K: 10X Visium HD Mouse Brain Triptych

Representative section (PBC44593) from the public 10X Visium HD murine brain dataset, at 16 µm bin resolution. The three panels share a single plasma color scale and identical grid bounds so the tissue silhouette aligns across all three:

- **4I — Spaceranger In-Tissue Spots** — bins SpaceRanger flagged `in_tissue == 1` (grey mask).
- **4J — Seurat Counts** — `log10(ncpm)` per bin from the Percula/Seurat counts matrix.
- **4K — RAD Counts** — `log10(ncpm)` per bin from the RAD whitelist-detection output for PBC44593.

Panels are generated by [`overview_panels_bare.R`](overview_panels_bare.R) (run separately — output PNGs are composited into the main figure outside this Rmd). The script reads:

- `${HD_MAPPING_DIR}/tissue_positions_16um.csv` (full grid)
- `${HD_MAPPING_DIR}/visium_hd_mouse_brain_016um_seurat.rds` (Percula counts)
- `sample_bin_matrix_16um.csv.gz` (RAD per-sample counts)

```{r panel-4i-4k}
# These panels are assembled outside this Rmd. To regenerate:
#   export HD_MAPPING_DIR=/path/to/visium_hd_mapping
#   Rscript overview_panels_bare.R
# Outputs (gitignored — re-derived locally):
#   overview_panel1_in_tissue_bare.png
#   overview_panel2_seurat_log10_ncpm_bare.png
#   overview_panel3_rad_log10_ncpm_bare.png
#   overview_triptych_bare.png
#   overview_colorbar_plasma.png  +  overview_colorbar_plasma_ncpm.png
#   overview_panels_bare_color_limits.csv

# (Prism tables for I/J/K live in the figure_4 Prism file under "visium HD overview".)
```
